integrity: Two explicit simple connected seven-vertex motifs and frozen 156-graph six-vertex atlas; all graph, polynomial, and divisor checks use bundled exact arithmetic; no third-party paper included; no independent audit or publication certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: Five algebraic real energies belong to the seven-cell but not six-cell single-cell flat-band set for simple unweighted periodic graph adjacency operators. title: Seven-cell counterexamples to an odd-even flat-band equality
